description: Hydropower Turbine Friction Monitoring Dataset is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Luleå Tekniska universitet. The datasets contain pressure and temperature signals from the hydraulic systems of two different Kaplan turbines. The variables can be connected to the forces required to regulate the runner blades on the turbines. The datasets can therefore be used to monitor the friction in the bearings that enable the movement of the runner blades. Coverage: Luleå Tekniska universitet. The publisher named on the listing is Luleå Tekniska universitet. Its keywords include predictive maintenance, bearings, glycerolsmörjning, friction, prediktivt underhåll, SCADA data. The listing shows 2025-03-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
